about: ATVO Enterprises Ltd is a Bhilwara-based textile-fabric trading and processing company. It is primarily into purchases and sales of finished fabric stock-in-trade, including fabric sent for processing, grading, and piece-packing, etc. Incorporated as Trendy Knitwear Ltd, it became Vandana Knitwear Ltd in 2012 and was renamed ATVO Enterprises Ltd in March 2025.
